newsitem.title: USA: Paris Club agrees 80 pct debt relief - French aide.
newsitem.headline: Paris Club agrees 80 pct debt relief - French aide.

text.p: The Group of Seven finance ministers took account on Saturday of an agreement reached by the Paris Club of creditor nations to give debt relief of up to 80 percent to the world's poorest nations, a French official said.
He said that Paris Club Chairman Christian Noyer was writing to Philippe Maystadt, head of the International Monetary Fund Interim Committee, today to confirm the Paris Club agreement.
Under the agreement, the Paris Club will offer debt relief of up to 80 percent on a case-by-case basis, instead of the 67 percent it currently offers.
The French official said the G7 took note of the Paris Club agreement in a chairman's statement to be released after the finance ministers' meeting.
